comparison.objective: Simultaneously release two lid latches, lift the lid, and place it beside the case; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated bilateral latch retraction and lifting of the same panel versus counterholding one threaded setting while another tool tightens its nut.
comparison.success_condition: Full score for the lid removed and resting flat beside the case; partial credit for one or both latches and lift progress.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous latch release and panel extraction are different from coupled screw/jam-nut torque control.
